sections.label: C

parts.label: Complete the word

sections.label: D
sections.title: Look and write the words.
sections.note: Complete each comparison with the correct adjective form.

questions.explanation: For a short adjective, add -er: fast becomes faster.
Theo thứ tự đề gốc, câu 2 so sánh Meg với Sue: slower.
Theo thứ tự đề gốc, câu 3 so sánh Lee với Ron: shorter.
Add -er to tall: Jan is taller than Ana.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Look and write the questions and answers.
sections.note: Write a complete question and a complete short answer for each picture.

parts.label: Question
answers: Is the box heavier than the ball?
Is the box heavier than the ball
parts.explanation: Use Is + subject + comparative + than: Is the box heavier than the ball?

parts.label: Answer
parts.explanation: The box is heavier, so the answer is Yes, it is.

parts.label: Question
answers: Is the car smaller than the bicycle?
Is the car smaller than the bicycle
parts.explanation: The complete question is: Is the car smaller than the bicycle?

parts.label: Answer
parts.explanation: The car is not smaller, so the answer is No, it isn't.

parts.label: Question

Is the bus longer than the train

parts.label: Answer

parts.label: Question

Is the dog bigger than the cat

parts.label: Answer

sections.label: G
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the word box. One word is extra.

questions.prompt: 1. She spilled water out of the glass. The floor is ___.
questions.explanation: Water on the floor makes it wet.

questions.prompt: 2. Her mother asked her to sit down about six times. The girl did not sit down. She was very ___.
questions.explanation: A stubborn person refuses to change or do what is requested.

questions.prompt: 3. The man shouted and his face was red. He was very ___.
questions.explanation: Shouting with a red face shows that the man was angry.

questions.prompt: 4. We want to climb a ___ called Everest.
questions.explanation: Everest is a mountain.
